name: @pipeworx/mcp-osrm

tools.name: route
tools.description: Compute the fastest route between two or more waypoints.

annotations.description: duration | nodes | distance | weight | datasources | speed | true | false

tools.name: table
tools.description: Distance / duration matrix between source and destination points.

sources.description: Indices into coordinates that are origins (default all)

destinations.description: Indices into coordinates that are destinations (default all)

tools.name: nearest
tools.description: Snap a single point to the nearest road segment.

tools.name: match
tools.description: Map-match a noisy GPS trace (semicolon-separated lon,lat pairs) to the road network via OSRM, optionally specifying per-point search radiuses in meters; returns matched route geometry and confidence.

radiuses.description: Per-point search radius in meters, semicolon-separated

tools.name: trip
tools.description: Solve a TSP-like trip between multiple waypoints.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-osrm forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the osrm pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
